+def _apply_merges_long(ids, ranks, merges_get, inf):
+    """
+    apply_merges() for long sequences, with the same merges in the same order.
+    Instead of min/index/count scans over the whole rank list at every step,
+    the number of positions holding each rank is kept in a dict and the ranks
+    present are kept in a heap (lazily: entries whose count dropped to zero
+    are skipped when popped), so a step costs one partial index() scan.
+    Invariant: every rank present in ranks (other than inf) has a heap entry.
+    """
+    cnt = {}
+    _count_elements(cnt, ranks)
+    heap = [r for r in cnt if r != inf]
+    heapify(heap)
+    cnt_get = cnt.get
+    while heap:
+        idx = heappop(heap)
+        k = cnt[idx]
+        if not k:
+            continue # stale entry: this rank is not present anymore
+        j = ranks.index(idx)
+        if k == 1:
+            # single occurrence: splice it in place, update the two neighbours
+            cnt[idx] = 0
+            ids[j] = idx
+            del ids[j+1]
+            del ranks[j]
+            if j:
+                cnt[ranks[j-1]] -= 1
+                r = ranks[j-1] = merges_get((ids[j-1], idx), inf)
+                c = cnt_get(r, 0)
+                cnt[r] = c + 1
+                if not c and r != inf:
+                    heappush(heap, r)
+            if j < len(ranks):
+                cnt[ranks[j]] -= 1
+                r = ranks[j] = merges_get((idx, ids[j+1]), inf)
+                c = cnt_get(r, 0)
+                cnt[r] = c + 1
+                if not c and r != inf:
+                    heappush(heap, r)
+            continue
+        # several occurrences: rebuild the lists as in apply_merges, recording
+        # the ranks that go away (olds) and the ones computed anew (news)
+        p0 = ids[j]
+        p1 = ids[j+1]
+        last = len(ranks) - 1
+        newids = []
+        ext = newids.extend
+        app = newids.append
+        newranks = []
+        rext = newranks.extend
+        rapp = newranks.append
+        olds = []
+        oapp = olds.append
+        news = []
+        napp = news.append
+        index = ranks.index
+        s = 0
+        first = True
+        while True:
+            k -= 1
+            if ids[j] == p0 and ids[j+1] == p1:
+                oapp(idx) # position j goes away
+                if s < j:
+                    if not first:
+                        r = merges_get((idx, ids[s]), inf)
+                        rapp(r)
+                        napp(r)
+                        oapp(ranks[s-1])
+                    rext(ranks[s:j-1])
+                    r = merges_get((ids[j-1], idx), inf)
+                    rapp(r)
+                    napp(r)
+                    oapp(ranks[j-1])
+                    ext(ids[s:j])
+                elif not first:
+                    r = merges_get((idx, idx), inf)
+                    rapp(r)
+                    napp(r)
+                    oapp(ranks[j-1])
+                app(idx)
+                first = False
+                s = j + 2
+                if j < last and ranks[j+1] == idx:
+                    k -= 1 # overlapping position j+1 is skipped
+                start = s
+            else:
+                start = j + 1
+            if not k:
+                break
+            j = index(idx, start)
+        if s <= last + 1:
+            r = merges_get((idx, ids[s]), inf)
+            rapp(r)
+            napp(r)
+            oapp(ranks[s-1])
+            rext(ranks[s:])
+            ext(ids[s:])
+        ids = newids
+        ranks = newranks
+        for r in olds:
+            cnt[r] -= 1
+        for r in news:
+            c = cnt_get(r, 0)
+            cnt[r] = c + 1
+            if not c and r != inf:
+                heappush(heap, r)
+        if cnt[idx]:
+            heappush(heap, idx) # positions with this rank are left
+    return ids
+
